description: Pipeline scope (pipeline-scope.sh, PermissionRequest) is the one command hook. For the scheduled pipeline only, marked by WORKBENCH_DEV_TEAM_PIPELINE=1 on the process bin/dispatch-agent.sh spawns, it allows a prompt for one plain git -C <dir>, rm, or rmdir command when every path is absolute and stays inside the roots: all of $TMPDIR, where every mktemp -d folder lands, so another run's clone is in scope too, and the scratch roots. The git subcommand must be add, checkout, commit, diff, log, merge, or push. It never allows a pull request merge, a force push, a push to the default branch, or a command a user deny rule matches. The hooks module (register.ts) holds the rest. It routes a dispatch of a dev-team agent to its mode agent, sets its model and effort from the config, and refuses a main-session brief that lacks a slot. On every Bash, Edit, Write, and NotebookEdit call it runs two guards, each reading the command through workbench-core's $.workbench.parseShell. The commit guard refuses a push that forces or deletes, a merge by a sub-agent or the pipeline, a sub-agent's commit or push, and a commit, push, or merge the permissions.ask rules cannot see. The review guard refuses a write outside the scratch roots by Holmes, his mode agents, his helper holmes-lens, or anything they spawned. Both catch mistakes and are not a security boundary.
